C0126.title: Exploiting Platform Loopholes for Fraudulent Gains: 'Petty Theft' May Lead to Criminal Charges
C0126.summary: In December 2021, CNR reported multiple cases of malicious exploitation of platform policies. A user in Wuhan exploited a food delivery platform's rapid refund policy by submitting photoshopped images of foreign objects, filing 115 fraudulent claims in six months and obtaining nearly 20,000 yuan, resulting in a fraud conviction.
